description: SQLite in the browser as a Stencil web component, on sql.js and IndexedDB, with an API that mirrors @capacitor-community/sqlite. The exact upstream jepiqueau/jeep-sqlite 2.8.0 with its loader and WebAssembly rebuilt together on current sql.js.
rules: Copy sql-wasm-browser.wasm from the package's wasm/ directory (or import 'jeep-sqlite-current-sqljs/sql-wasm-browser.wasm') into the public assets path (default /assets, or set the wasmPath property); a missing binary surfaces as 'TypeError: x is not a function'.
Never pair the loader with a WebAssembly binary from a different sql.js release: it fails with a LinkError.
Register the element with defineCustomElements from 'jeep-sqlite-current-sqljs/loader'.
Applications do not need rollup-plugin-node-polyfills: the polyfills are bundled in the distribution.
A database is persisted to IndexedDB on close, closeConnection or saveToStore, or after every change when the autosave property is set.
Await customElements.whenDefined('jeep-sqlite') and isStoreOpen() before the first call.
